detail.longDescription: Present-day me isn't afraid to admit that early in my freelancing career, I quoted clients based on my memory of what I charged other clients. And when that memory failed me (which was often), I went with whatever number felt the least likely to scare a new prospect away. A Google Sheets price list gives you one place to lock in your rates and quickly build quotes customized to your client requests without digging through old emails for your last quote or second-guessing yourself mid-call.
